editorial.blurb: This South Loop rotary sushi bar delivers genuine freshness and fun with an all-you-can-eat format that feels like an adventure—especially for first-timers.
editorial.insiderTip: Do the AYCE lunch deal if budget-conscious; it's well-priced and includes nearly everything except sashimi and cheesecake. Use the iPad to order items you missed on the conveyor belt, and watch for the Psyduck desserts rolling by.
